verdict.rationale: The pack includes a dedicated first-party docs page for Bits AI [datadog-docs-4], so Datadog ships a built-in AI assistant, but the evidence is only a page title with no detail on what tasks can be delegated to it or how. Missing for 10: documented task-delegation capabilities (e.g., investigations, queries, or actions Bits AI performs on the user's behalf), scope or limits of its autonomy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
